note: Browse categories based on the eligibility text already recorded on PermaBrella. This is not a new eligibility verification. A changed eligibility summary requires reclassification; uncertain or restricted applicant types remain under Eligibility to confirm.

entries.title: Ballina Shire Council - Community Donations
entries.eligibility: Eligible community organisations in Ballina Shire

entries.title: Ballina Shire Council - Resource Recovery Community Grants
entries.eligibility: Individuals, organisations and community groups delivering waste reduction or resource recovery projects within Ballina Shire.

entries.title: Byron Shire Council - Community Initiatives Grant
entries.eligibility: Incorporated community organisations and groups with auspice arrangements in Byron Shire

entries.title: Byron Shire Council — Regenerative Agriculture Small Grants
entries.eligibility: Eligible primary producers, market gardeners and small-scale farmers in Byron Shire, subject to the current round's land and applicant requirements.

entries.title: Clarence Valley Council - Community Initiatives Program
entries.eligibility: Eligible incorporated organisations, groups with an ABN and bank account, or auspiced individuals delivering community benefit in Clarence Valley.

entries.title: Community Building Partnership 2026
entries.eligibility: Eligible local community organisations and councils including incorporated associations, public companies limited by guarantee, Local Aboriginal Land Councils, Indigenous corporations, NSW local councils, section 355 committees, ACNC-registered trusts, and registered P&C Associations.

entries.title: Community Resilience Grants Program
entries.eligibility: Eligible not-for-profit organisations delivering flood recovery and/or resilience services to people in the 7 Northern Rivers LGAs, with annual gross revenue below $5 million.

entries.title: FRRR - Strengthening Rural Communities: Small & Vital
entries.eligibility: Not-for-profit organisations, or groups with an eligible auspice, benefiting rural, remote or very remote Australian communities. Small grants prioritise communities with fewer than 15,000 residents; check the guidelines for your location.

entries.title: FRRR — Strengthening Rural Communities: Capacity Building
entries.eligibility: Eligible not-for-profits serving agriculture-dependent rural and regional communities, with an ABN or incorporation certificate, or an approved legal organisation supporting the application.

entries.title: FRRR — Strengthening Rural Communities: Prepare & Recover
entries.eligibility: Australian not-for-profits with an ABN or incorporation, or groups using an eligible auspice, with a charitable project benefiting a rural, remote or regional community.

entries.title: Kyogle Council - Community Grant Program
entries.eligibility: Not-for-profit organisations and individuals in the Kyogle LGA

entries.title: Lismore City Council — Rural Landholders Initiative
entries.eligibility: Eligible rural landholders with properties larger than 2 hectares in Lismore LGA, and eligible community groups under the applicable stream. Projects must protect or improve biodiversity, include cash or in-kind contributions and ongoing maintenance, and meet Council's rates requirements.

entries.title: NSW Biodiversity Conservation Trust — Conservation Partners Grants
entries.eligibility: Eligible NSW landowners with listed conservation agreements, Trust agreements, registered property agreements, wildlife refuge status or Wildlife Land Trust membership. Excludes biodiversity stewardship/offset agreements and new agreements already receiving BCT annual management payments.

entries.title: NSW Biodiversity Conservation Trust — Rainforest Conservation Offer
entries.eligibility: Eligible landowners within the mapped offer area in Ballina, Byron, Kyogle, Lismore, Richmond Valley and Tweed LGAs, willing to enter an in-perpetuity agreement. Published site requirements include at least 20 hectares of native vegetation, including 15 hectares of qualifying rainforest in moderate to good condition.

entries.title: NSW EPA and NSW Aboriginal Land Council — Together on Country
entries.eligibility: Eligible NSW Local Aboriginal Land Councils. LALCs under administration and previous Together on Country grant recipients are excluded.

entries.title: NSW EPA – Business Food Waste Partnership Grants
entries.eligibility: Peak bodies, sector leaders, councils, educators and other relevant organisations working with food-wasting businesses.

entries.title: NSW EPA – Food Rescue Grants
entries.eligibility: Food rescue and/or relief organisations and coordinating organisations such as not-for-profits, NSW councils, NSW local government regional waste groups or regional organisations of councils.

entries.title: NSW Environmental Trust – Environmental Education
entries.eligibility: Community groups, not-for-profit organisations, state and local government, non-commercial cooperatives, councils, universities, regional organisations of councils, NSW local Aboriginal Land Councils, and registered NSW Aboriginal Corporations.

entries.title: NSW Environmental Trust – Environmental Restoration and Rehabilitation
entries.eligibility: State and local government and community groups.

entries.title: NSW Environmental Trust – Protecting Our Places
entries.eligibility: NSW Aboriginal community organisations or groups.

entries.title: Northern Rivers Community Foundation - Community Grants Program
entries.eligibility: Not-for-profit groups and eligible community organisations in the seven Northern Rivers LGAs

entries.title: Northern Rivers Community Foundation - Recovery and Resilience Grants Program
entries.eligibility: Northern Rivers not-for-profit community groups impacted by disaster

entries.title: Richmond Valley Council - Community Financial Assistance Program
entries.eligibility: Eligible community groups in the Richmond Valley

entries.title: Rous County Council — Community Grants
entries.eligibility: Eligible organisations, incorporated not-for-profits, businesses, schools, universities, sports clubs and associations in Ballina, Byron, Kyogle, Lismore, Richmond Valley or Tweed LGAs. Public liability insurance is required.

entries.title: Tweed Shire Council - Community Grants Program
entries.eligibility: Community groups and not-for-profits in the Tweed region

entries.title: Tweed Shire Council — River Health Grants
entries.eligibility: Rural landowners in Tweed Shire proposing work that improves water quality or stream health. Priority includes protecting drinking-water catchments.

entries.title: Tweed Shire Council — Sustainable Agriculture Small Grants
entries.eligibility: Primary producers or people actively farming land in Tweed Shire, proposing work with clear environmental benefits.
